- Ops/security: allowlist, audit logs, and data flows for hosted deployments

Date: 2026-05-19T18:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API integration architecture review - availability

Thanks Priya —

Short answers up front:
- Function/tool calling: our hosted API supports structured function calling via the SDKs (we'll demo a tool connector pattern). For connecting to customer webhooks/services we typically recommend using the function-calling response to trigger a customer-managed webhook; we will walk through a safe pattern (bounded retries, auth tokens) during the demo.
- Streaming: we support continuous token streaming and incremental chunking in SDKs; very long generations are handled via streaming + KV cache checkpoints. We don't provide resumable streams across client disconnects today (we can recommend patterns for periodic checkpointing).

Action items before the call:
- Acme: share average/peak token counts and a sample prompt set (can be redacted).
- Acme IT Ops: please share IPs or egress ranges that need to be allowlisted.

I've created the calendar invite for Tue 2026-05-20 10:00-11:15 PST and linked the Zoom. If anything changes, reply here and we'll reschedule.

Marissa
